chunks: And in it, that the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, did not grant Satan authority over the believers except over those who follow him.
And He granted him authority over the disbelievers.
ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the Shia doctrine that Satan's dominion is conditional upon human choice, distinguishing between those who voluntarily submit to his whispers and those who remain steadfast in faith. This clarifies that 'authority' (sultan) is not an absolute coercion but a consequence of following one's desires, reinforcing the concept of free will within divine decree. The narration underscores that true believers are exempt from Satan's ultimate control as long as they maintain their spiritual vigilance.
